cipherHowTo.caesar: Shift code. Every letter in the note moved forward by the same number of places in the alphabet. After Z, counting carries on from A. Step 1: the first word is really THE. Count how many places T moved to become the first letter shown. Step 2: move every letter of the second word back by that many places. Worked example with a shift of 1: CAT is written DBU. To decode DBU, move each letter back 1.
cipherHowTo.atbash: Mirror code. The alphabet was flipped: A became Z, B became Y, C became X, and so on until Z became A. The first word is really THE, so you can check the flip on it first. Flip every letter of the second word the same way to decode it. Worked example: CAT is written XZG. To decode XZG, flip each letter back.
cipherHowTo.pairswap: Swap code. The letters were swapped in pairs: the 1st with the 2nd, the 3rd with the 4th, and so on. Swap each pair back to decode the word. Worked example: BOAT is written OBTA.
